author: richburdon
body:
Replace with:

```tsx
<Grid rows={db ? 2 : 1}>
  db && <ObjectTree />
  <Json />
</Grid>
```

If you need scrolling

```tsx
<ScrollArea.Root>
  <ScrollArea.Viewport>
    <ObjectTree />
  </ScrollArea.Viewport>
</ScrollArea.Root>
```

`Json` takes care of its own scrolling

From now on, flag any place where you would previously use <div> and classNames -- I am removing the need for this; by default Container, Flex, Grid, and ScrollArea (new react-ui primitives) will expand and "just work". no interventions necessary. They will also work web/mobile. The goal is to completely remove UI-implementation specific constructs from all plugins. I'm progressively removing these using agents. This will make for a MUCH more uniform experience and allow us to progressively factor out more performant components (and ultimately perhaps allow us to auto-migrate to solid). It'll also reduce clutter and the frustration we all have felt jumping into CSS arcanery.
